python3 -c "
# Iron-depleted (GluFe) significant pathways (adj_p < 0.05)
glufe_sig = set()
with open('/workspace/glufe_kegg_ora.tsv') as f:
    header = f.readline().strip().split('\t')
    adj_p_idx = header.index('adjusted_p_value')
    pid_idx = header.index('pathway_id')
    for line in f:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        cols = line.strip().split('\t')
        adj_p = float(cols[adj_p_idx])
        if adj_p < 0.05:
            glufe_sig.add(cols[pid_idx])

# Innate media (Succ) significant pathways (adj_p < 0.05)
succ_sig = set()
with open('/workspace/succ_kegg_ora.tsv') as f:
    header = f.readline().strip().split('\t')
    adj_p_idx = header.index('adjusted_p_value')
    pid_idx = header.index('pathway_id')
    for line in f:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        cols = line.strip().split('\t')
        adj_p = float(cols[adj_p_idx])
        if adj_p < 0.05:
            succ_sig.add(cols[pid_idx])

print(f'Iron-depleted significant pathways ({len(glufe_sig)}):')
for p in sorted(glufe_sig):
    print(f'  {p}')

print(f'\nInnate media significant pathways ({len(succ_sig)}):')
for p in sorted(succ_sig):
    print(f'  {p}')

iron_only = glufe_sig - succ_sig
print(f'\nIron-depleted ONLY (not significant in innate media): {len(iron_only)}')
for p in sorted(iron_only):
    print(f'  {p}')
"
